label: Zupančič critiques Deleuzian vitalism of positive difference, defending the negative gap and constitutive deadlock in Being
description: Alenka Zupančič engaged in a direct critique of Gilles Deleuze's foundational principles, rejecting core axioms in favor of a dialectically opposed framework.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Gilles Deleuze's perspective to Alenka Zupančič's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Contemporary & Post-Structural era.
